description: Freight Train Movement Data from ARTC is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by Australian Rail Track Corporation (ARTC). Train count and speed have been modelled by analysing GPS pings transmitted by trains and assigning them to the nearest point on the nearest rail segment. This data has been summarised by train service and rail segment for publication. The GeoJSON map includes track gauge, length and geospatial lines. Users can use it to visualise average speed and calculate distance travelled for each train service. Coverage is Australia, 2018 to 2023; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as twice a year, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-02-26. Files and pages listed: CSV, GeoJSON (4 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
